dedupe_keys.name: 応急給水資機材の配備場所 drinking water supply

description: 応急給水資機材の配備場所 [drinking water supply] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 宮崎市. 災害等による断水発生に伴い応急給水活動を行う場合に備え、市内22か所の避難所に応急給水資機材を配備しており、配備場所と住所、資機材の種別を公表するもの。. Coverage: 宮崎市. The portal files it under the publisher 宮崎市. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2026-03-13 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
